name: Bani
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: The Levites are named, Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, and Mattaniah who was over the thanksgiving, with Bakbukiah and Unni set over against them in the watches. This is the register of those who returned to serve.

note.label: Nehemiah 12: The Priests, the Levites, and the Dedication of the Wall
